content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Shreveport

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your project leadership and oversight hours before applying.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Our instructor-led course covers the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains on a schedule that fits working professionals in Healthcare, Energy, Aerospace, Manufacturing, and other Shreveport-area industries.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your bootcamp hours, submit your formal application directly to PMI, including proof of education, project experience, and contact-hour completion from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI exam fee when your application is approved.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce key concepts. Schedule your exam at a Pearson Vue testing center and take the computer-based PMP® exam at your own pace.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP®, maintain it by earning professional development units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy and PMI offer multiple pathways—training, volunteering, publications, and mentoring—to stay current and keep your credential active.
